title: Use one adaptive Theseus loop skill
summary: Applied by the approved replacement run contract, whose later slices deliver one adaptive theseus-loop skill and retain long mode as compatibility behavior.

sourceRefs.intent: Use one user-facing theseus-loop skill with automatic risk- and scope-based recommendation between iteration and long modes. State the selected mode and reasons before approval, allow explicit user override, and never silently escalate an approved iteration into a long run. Retain theseus-long-loop only as a compatibility alias that forces long mode.
